## What does this PR do?

- [ ] Adds a new API
- [ ] Fixes or updates an existing entry
- [ ] Improves docs / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] The API has full free access, or at least a free tier
- [ ] Entry follows the format in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md): `| [Name](link) | Description | Auth | HTTPS | CORS |`
- [ ] Added in the correct category, in **alphabetical order**
- [ ] Name does not end with `API` and does not include a TLD
- [ ] Description is capitalized, has no trailing punctuation and is at most 100 characters
- [ ] **One API per pull request**, title formatted as `Add Api-name API`
- [ ] The API has proper public documentation
